insights.text:
It's all in timing the jump after the magic dash, it kind of propels you. But it is a irritating place to fail at, as the run to that part is so tedious.

recordings.title: Fastest Kuldra Run Runescape Dragonwilds post Patch 1.0.1 Raid skips!
recordings.summary: With the launch of the new update today, they have patched some skips in the raid. Thankfully a couple still work including the boss skip, however I've had to find a couple of work arounds. Take a look at the run, and let me know if you've found anything i might have missed.

notes: YouTube comment dates are approximate: yt-dlp derives them from relative ages ("2 weeks ago") at fetch time 2026-11-03.

verified: yes = shown on video, verified on SRC or confirmed by several people; partial = one corroboration; self-shown = the author demonstrates it in their own video; no = unverified claim; disputed = contradicted; outdated = true at the time, since patched.
